title: `DAIInterestRateModelV3.poke()` Publicly Callable + Division-Before-Multiplication Precision Loss
impact: (a) `poke()` is `public` with no access control — anyone can call it, but more importantly it reads `jug.ilks("ETH-A")` and `pot.dsr()` which may be stale until Maker's `drip()`/`fold()` is called, allowing a caller to checkpoint a momentarily manipulated DSR/stability-fee into `baseRatePerBlock`/`multiplierPerBlock`, mispricing the cDAI market until the next poke. (b) In `dsrPerBlock()` and `stabilityFeePerBlock`, division by `RAY_TO_BASE_SCALE` occurs **before** multiplication by `SECONDS_PER_BLOCK`, truncating up to `1e9`-scale precision per step and systematically understating rates.
